_header: NEGATIVE-CONSTRAINT MEMORY. Every idea this project already killed, with the failure mode that killed it. The critic matches each new proposal against `blocks` BEFORE it can occupy a slot, so a dead idea cannot be resurrected by an agent that never lived through its death. Seeded 2026-07-27 from the real project history. Append-only; a human --decline reason lands here too.

why: You only know which candle was the peak after later candles fail to exceed it. Idealised 71% WR/+1.9% EV collapsed to causal 50% WR/+0.15%, matching live 48%.
Live hint 22-32% WR across three June windows; 249d honest check gave 55.8% = exactly the rest. The three confirmations reused the window that generated the claim.
Refuted on 5k trades; no discontinuity at the 2.5/3x boundary. Live 78% was n=23 noise.
Waiting for a confirmation candle gives a WORSE short entry. Measured: 1h wait enters 1.78% lower on 84% of trades. Confirmed four ways.
Live said US session 44% WR, 06h UTC 11% WR. Honest 249d: US is the BEST session, 06h is fine at 55%, and every skip-scenario loses gross return.
Live isolated 65% vs cascade 38% (p=.047 on 7d). Honest 249d: 56.1% vs 57.1% — and 11+ clusters were actually best.
-1305% total PnL.
Fresh window showed 8-10% pumps at 67% WR. Honest: flat EV at all levels — a WR dial only, and it pays volume. Superseded the earlier 'top recommendation' of pump>=8 & vol>=3.
No discontinuity at the boundary.
Live p=.066 became flat at p=.58 on honest data.
Honest Thu = 52.8%. The live signal was literally one bad day (Jul 2).
70% vs 35% live became 57.7% vs 55.6% — flat.
$0.1-1 was worst live and best on cache — directly contradictory.
Split-half WR correlation r = -0.002. Bad coins do not stay bad. Coin lists are pointless.
0 of 169 live trades were <30d coins — no new HL listings in the window. PARKED as dormant, not dead.

claim: Funding as a hard gate / side strategy
why: A real but WEAK lever. The best cell (60.5% mild-bull sweet spot) failed a permutation test — exactly what you expect from picking the max of 6 noisy buckets. Survives only as a non-skipping ghost flag.

claim: Raising the pump threshold to lift EV
why: Lifts WR 56->62% but NOT net EV — losses balloon from -3.95 to -7.97 via the peak-anchored SL; >=20% goes negative.
Killed as a look-ahead phantom.
Measurement artifact. Shorts win on strong directional moves either way and lose in grind/chop; the live 'bull collapse' was the moderate-rising bucket mislabelled strong_bull by a laggy 7d metric.

claim: BTC-regime / coin-beta interaction as a filter
why: No surviving filter ever shipped. btc_regime=neutral remains a pending hypothesis at p=0.102 uncorrected — dead at any corrected bar.
An artifact of post-hoc clipping — shrinking recorded SL losses without moving the actual stop. True path-sim: the cap COSTS ~5% of total PnL.

claim: Don't skip extreme wicks — best WR bucket
why: Not refuted, RE-LENSED. WR rises with wick but EV inverts: at 0.2% fee the 4%+ bucket is net -0.127%/t while carrying the entire -30% tail. Do NOT un-ship the skip without re-running fee-adjusted EV.
The freeze triggers on doubling — a WINNING condition. It is a profit-capping rule, not a loss-limiting one. B >= A at every WR from 80% down to 45%, identical max DD.
Rejected twice: the '+59% sweep cell' was 18-trade variance, then it failed Bonferroni (p=0.091 vs a 1.7e-3 bar). Survives only as a ghost.
A 56-cell sweep on n=18 is massive data-snooping risk. Rejected on the n=300 cache.
Did not improve at scale — uptrend pumps short BETTER.

claim: BTC macro filter (skip if BTC +24h > X%)
why: Did not improve EV.
Ghost 81.5% vs taken 64.7% looked huge but Welch p~0.20 with a single-regime confound.
n=4 (1W/3L). Meaningless, and no prior theoretical reason.

claim: Sweep wallet 0x010461... as an alpha source
why: That wallet has ZERO Hyperliquid activity. Decisive negative result.

claim: Reservoir / Hydromancer S3 as a third data source
why: Requester-pays and only covers HL perps from Aug 2025 — cannot fill the Feb-Aug gap.

claim: HL candleSnapshot as the 2y history source
why: Only serves ~208 days at 1h; Feb-Nov 2025 returns 0 candles, and coarser intervals cannot be down-converted. Forced the Binance proxy.
Dominated: 1h-detect / 15m-execute matches it on EV with lower drawdown while keeping the proven filter.
Looks safest but guts the engine: WR 79% -> 60%. Shaken out by pumps making a new high before dumping.
Not wrong — disqualified on population robustness. NEGATIVE on Binance (-0.180%/t), and its best variant (15m+TP7) is the top HL number and dead out-of-sample.
INVERTED population logic — an 8-point statistic on a different population cannot veto a p<0.0001 result on the right one. This produced the binding evidence hierarchy.
Registry metadata said retired while the bot kept trading at n=120, EV +0.736 — the fleet's best — silently excluded from every verdict for 6 weeks.
Counted outcome LABELS including negative-PnL 'tp_hits', and excluded timeouts. Honest number was 61.5%.
Became 70% purely by counting timeouts honestly. Two different devs hit the same trap.

claim: Generalising from the 12-coin cache to the full universe
why: The validated +2.65% EV applies to ESTABLISHED coins only; the bot monitors 177 including PURR, HMSTR, XPL, MEME — none in the cached validation.

claim: The pump-short edge generalises across venues
why: It is a thin-alt mean-reversion phenomenon. BASE net EV/t +0.149% on HL vs -0.180% on Binance; 145 of 172 HL coins are HL-only. KEPT AS A FINDING: this strategy will NOT scale to large size.

claim: Anchoring the stop to entry instead of the pump peak reduces the variance of realised loss size without lowering win rate.
why: screen kill — worse on BOTH halves of the objective: WR -9.10pp (paired p=9.18e-41 vs α=0.01250, b=0/c=134) and EV -0.0151%/trade on n=1474. An arm losing on win rate is only worth keeping if it is buying EV; this one is not.
